In the USA, CDC3 recommends a single intravenous or intramuscular injection of ceftriaxone 25 to 50 mg/kg (up to 125 mg) when there is no evidence of disseminat- ed infection. See also under Gonorrhoea (p.191) for the treatment of infants exposed to gonorrhoea at birth or with estab- lished gonococcal infection at any site. For nongonococcal neonatal conjunctivitis WHO4 and CDC3 recommend erythromycin 50 mg/kg daily in 4 di- vided doses orally for 14 days; WHO4 recommend co- trimoxazole 240 mg twice daily for 14 days as an alter- native.
